summary: Iteration 25 — Bi-directional remittance (Africa → UK/EU) Phase 1 MVP. Ran 21 pytest cases covering GET /api/remit/reverse/corridors, POST /api/remit/reverse/quote (8 combos × happy + 4 validation), POST /api/waitlist/join direction segmentation (inbound, explicit outbound, missing field default, invalid value default), GET /api/admin/waitlist/stats (admin/403 + unauthenticated), and outbound regression (GET /api/remit/corridors returns 11, POST /api/remit/quote for KE 200). Result: 21/21 PASS (100%). Kotani mode observed exactly as spec'd: KE and ZA return 'live' (£139.93 and £222.28 respectively for GBP), NG and GH auto-fall-back to 'estimated' (£45.74 and £139.72). All amounts populate > 0, fees > 0, bridge USDC on POLYGON is emitted. Validation cases return 400 with helpful 'minimum'/'maximum'/'unsupported' copy in detail. Waitlist direction defaults correctly to 'outbound' when field missing OR invalid ('sideways'). Admin endpoint currently returns 403 for smoke user because ADMIN_EMAILS env var is not configured — that is the documented expected behaviour per the review request; the test asserts 200-or-403 and passes on 403. Unauthenticated request to admin endpoint returns 403 as well. No bugs found.

test_details.corridors_catalog: PASS — 4 sources {NG, KE, GH, ZA}; 2 destinations {GBP, EUR}; bridge=USDC/POLYGON; status=quote_only; every source has min_amount, max_amount, use_cases (non-empty list), flag, fund_via.
test_details.reverse_quote_happy_8_combos: PASS — NG/KE/GH/ZA × GBP/EUR. Live modes: KE, ZA. Estimated (Kotani sandbox onramp disabled): NG, GH. Sample: NG 100,000 NGN → 45.74 GBP, bridge 62.47 USDC, total fee $3.56.
test_details.reverse_quote_validation: PASS — below-min (NG 100 NGN → 400 'minimum'); above-max (NG 10M NGN → 400 'maximum'); unsupported source XX → 400; unsupported destination USD → 400.
test_details.waitlist_inbound: PASS — {corridor:NG, direction:inbound} → 200 with echoed direction=inbound, corridor=NG.
test_details.waitlist_missing_direction: PASS — omitting direction defaults to 'outbound' (backward compat).
test_details.admin_stats_or_403: PASS — ADMIN_EMAILS not configured on this deployment so smoke user gets 403 (expected). Unauthenticated call also 403. If admin were enabled, endpoint would return {total, by_corridor, by_direction:{outbound,inbound}, matrix:[{corridor,direction,count}...]}, breakdown, corridors — code path reviewed and confirmed correct.
test_details.regression_outbound_corridors: PASS — GET /api/remit/corridors returns 11 outbound corridors, list unchanged.
test_details.regression_outbound_quote_ke: PASS — POST /api/remit/quote {source_fiat:GBP, amount:100, destination_code:KE} → 200 with same shape as before.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) If you want the smoketest@vaulted.app user to be able to hit /api/admin/waitlist/stats in prod-preview, add ADMIN_EMAILS=smoketest@vaulted.app to /app/backend/.env and restart backend. Currently unset, so all callers get 403 — this is the fail-closed behaviour defined in deps.require_admin.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/reverse_remit.py cleanly implements the fallback to _mock_onramp_rate when Kotani sandbox responds with 'not available' — verified live against sandbox for NG and GH. Both flags come through as kotani.mode='estimated', matching product spec.

routers/waitlist.py correctly normalises invalid direction values (e.g. 'sideways') to 'outbound' rather than 400-ing — that's important for backward compat with older landing-page JS that doesn't send the field.

Admin endpoint uses a fail-closed default (403 when ADMIN_EMAILS is empty). This is safer than fail-open but means the endpoint is unreachable on any deployment where the env var wasn't set — expected here.
Waitlist rate-limiter is in-memory (_last_seen_by_ip dict) so it doesn't survive process restarts and isn't shared across multiple gunicorn workers. Fine for MVP but worth flagging for prod scale.
